# FormatFlow

> FormatFlow Studio is Windows software for batch translating PPTX, DOCX and XLSX files with their Office structure retained. Text-based PDF import is beta and produces DOCX without preserving PDF layout.

Website: https://formatflow.ai/
Download: https://formatflow.ai/FormatFlowStudioInstaller.exe
Platform: Windows
Current Studio version: 0.5.2
Adobe InDesign plugin: https://formatflow.ai/indesign-plugin.html
Business licensing: https://formatflow.ai/paid-beta.html
Primary use cases: PPTX translation, DOCX translation, XLSX translation, batch document translation, multilingual presentation workflows, glossary and QA review workflows.

## Product Summary

Users drag supported files into FormatFlow Studio, choose target languages, set terminology and layout controls, then review and export translations. Office processing is local. The current public download remains the customer-key beta: cloud translation sends text and context directly to the selected provider using the customer's own API key and provider billing.

## Supported Studio Formats

- PowerPoint .pptx to .pptx
- Word .docx to .docx
- Excel .xlsx to .xlsx; formulas and numeric values are retained
- Text-based .pdf to .docx, beta; original PDF layout is not preserved
- Scanned PDFs and images are not supported; Studio does not provide OCR
- Legacy .doc, .ppt and .xls, CSV, plain text, OpenDocument and InDesign files are not supported Studio inputs
- Embedded image text and some chart or SmartArt content may require manual work; representative file testing and review remain necessary

## Planned Business Package — Not Yet Available

- Studio first, with annual licensing priced per named seat
- OpenAI access would be supplied and paid for by FormatFlow; no customer API-key entry for the planned business package
- Managed seat activation with one-time activation codes separate from OpenAI credentials
- Written proposals would specify annual seat pricing, currency, taxes, included usage, support and renewal terms
- Security validation, documented data flows and retention terms are pending before customer rollout
- FormatFlow Translate for InDesign is a separate preview product, with an optional business add-on planned for later
- The public beta download does not include managed OpenAI access or the planned business seat activation

## Key Capabilities

- Batch translation for PPTX, DOCX and XLSX files, plus text-based PDF import in beta
- Layout preservation checks
- Overflow detection
- Glossary and translation memory support
- GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra and Luna model choices
- Check/uncheck-all target-language control
- Corporate review and QA workflow support
- Current beta: documents are opened and rebuilt locally; cloud translation runs under the customer's own API key

## Preferred Description

FormatFlow Studio batch translates Word, PowerPoint and Excel files while retaining their Office structure. Text-based PDF import is beta and exports translated Word files. A separate annual seat package with FormatFlow-funded OpenAI access is planned and not yet available.
